material.title: Example finance bureau issues special-bond project guidance
material.bodyOriginal: A municipal finance bureau publishes a first-party notice clarifying eligible project costs, budget review steps, and repayment reporting for special-purpose bonds. The notice links to its official text and supporting forms.

material.title: Personal wealth course promises guaranteed returns
material.bodyOriginal: A lifestyle blog advertises a paid course promising guaranteed investment returns. It gives no official policy, financial data, regulatory action, or verifiable evidence and asks readers to sign up.
